# mtncloud_mos_bucket_cors (Resource)

Which web pages may call a MOS bucket from a browser (CORS). This resource holds all of the bucket's rules; destroy removes them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket" "site" {
  name = "acme-website"
}

resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket_cors" "site" {
  bucket = mtncloud_mos_bucket.site.name
  rule = [
    {
      allowed_origins = ["https://www.example.com"]
      allowed_methods = ["GET", "HEAD"]
      max_age_seconds = 3600
    },
    {
      id              = "browser-uploads"
      allowed_origins = ["https://app.example.com"]
      allowed_methods = ["PUT", "POST"]
      allowed_headers = ["*"]
      expose_headers  = ["ETag"]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The bucket's name in MOS, usually `mtncloud_mos_bucket.<name>.name`. Changing it moves the setting to another bucket.
- `rule` (Attributes Set) The rules, 1 to 100. Their order has no meaning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule))

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The bucket's name.

<a id="nestedatt--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `allowed_methods` (Set of String) HTTP methods allowed: `GET`, `PUT`, `POST`, `DELETE` or `HEAD`.
- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) Origins allowed, for example `https://app.example.com`, or `*` for any.

Optional:

- `allowed_headers` (Set of String) Request headers allowed, or `*` for any.
- `expose_headers` (Set of String) Response headers the browser may read.
- `id` (String) A name for the rule.
- `max_age_seconds` (Number) How long a browser may cache the answer to a preflight request, 1 to 86400 seconds.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_mos_bucket_cors.site acme-website
```
